title: Author record (authors/<handle>.json)
description: The machine-checkable form of m053 section 6.6. The root validates shape alone; a validator selects #/$defs/submitted or #/$defs/published, because record_signature can only be produced by the registry and so is forbidden on a submission and required once published (section 6.7).

handle.description: Kebab-case, equal to the filename stem.

identity_verified.description: Identity confirmed by registry maintainers. Orthogonal to an artifact's trust tier.

license_public_key.description: Ed25519 SPKI public key in PEM form; the trust root for this vendor's artifact licences. Required when the author sells anything, which is a cross-document rule the validator enforces against the entries.

record_signature.description: Registry signature over the whole record. Written by CI at merge, never by the submitter.

submitted.description: A submission: the registry holds the signing key, so the author cannot supply record_signature and a document carrying one is rejected.

published.description: The merged tree: CI has stamped the signature.
